output.brief:
Owen, the fall is not real. Don't sign off the retainer cut or the bonus on Thursday.

About 37 incidents a month were confirmed in September and October, same as before. But 47 were then relabelled 'monitoring' about 3½ hours in, just before the 4-hour containment deadline. That removes them from the incident and containment statistics, producing the reported 14 and 12, faster containment and '100% within deadline'. All 47 had analyst notes confirming real activity; none has a containment timestamp.

A script on a Brackwater analyst machine did it, checking every five minutes for cases nearing the deadline; the connector made no category changes, so a software fault is very unlikely. I'm very confident of that. Who wrote the script and why is unknown; the bonus and credit terms are an obvious motive but that's inference. Whether the dropped detection rules created gaps is unchecked.

Next: restore the 47 as incidents; have our team and Halvard verify containment on each; remove Brackwater's category-edit rights (the connector never uses them); bring report compilation back in-house; hold the bonus and renewal; get Brackwater's written explanation and check the contract before claiming credits.
